title: NJGIN Property Explorer
usefulFor: Confirming the parcel before searching permits
Checking whether a result belongs to an adjacent lot
caveat: Parcel geometry is not a survey or legal boundary. County and municipal stewards remain responsible for source data.
requestMethod: Public online search; no records request is needed for the displayed parcel data.
requestRequirements: Start with address, then preserve municipality plus block/lot or PIN for downstream searches.
fallbackRoute: Use the county parcel steward or municipal tax assessor when the statewide composite is stale or ambiguous.

title: NJDEP DataMiner
agency: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
usefulFor: Finding NJDEP case and site records
Checking whether a known incident or remediation file exists
Getting identifiers for the next document search
caveat: No result is not proof that a tank never existed. Search spelling, local permit files, and older paper records can still matter.
requestRequirements: Repeat by address variants and any identifier recovered from another source.
responseTime: Immediate when the system is available
fallbackRoute: Use DocMiner for documents, then NJDEP OPRA for records not available online.

title: NJDEP DocMiner
agency: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
usefulFor: Following the document trail behind an agency identifier
caveat: The repository is expanding and may not contain every older or sensitive record. Local construction and fire permits live outside NJDEP.
requestMethod: Search and export available documents through the public interface.
requestRequirements: Use all known address and entity-name variants; preserve any DEP identifiers returned.
fallbackRoute: Submit an NJDEP OPRA request that names the address, municipality, identifiers, record types, and date range.

title: NJDEP Open Public Records Act request
usefulFor: Requesting records not available in DataMiner or DocMiner
Narrowing a request to a known case or site
caveat: A public-record request retrieves existing records; it does not ask the agency to create a property conclusion.
requestMethod: Submit the online OPRA form; NJDEP also publishes a downloadable request form and records-custodian contact.
requestRequirements: Describe specific record types and date ranges and include every recovered site or case identifier.
fee: Agency confirms any applicable reproduction fee
responseTime: Agency response depends on scope; track the request confirmation and stated estimate
fallbackRoute: Contact Records.Custodian@dep.nj.gov or 609-341-3121 with the request number.

title: Montclair Properties Information Portal
caveat: The Township directs users to SDL before OPRA for information already available there. A free SDL account and valid email are required.
requestMethod: Create a free SDL account and search the Montclair property record.
requestRequirements: Search address and block/lot; save permit or control numbers for follow-up.
fee: Free account; no search fee shown
fallbackRoute: File a Township OPRA request through montclair-township-nj.nextrequest.com for specific missing existing records.

title: ORPTS Municipal Data Portal
agency: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
usefulFor: Finding the correct local assessor and jurisdiction
Reviewing recent property sales and transfers outside NYC
caveat: Assessment and sales records identify the parcel and history; they do not establish tank installation, closure, or environmental condition.
requestMethod: Use Municipal Profiles to identify the local assessor and official municipal site; use Sales Web for recent transfers.
requestRequirements: Preserve the SWIS code and SBL/print key used by local permit and records offices.
fallbackRoute: Contact the local assessor or county Real Property Tax Services office for the roll or parcel card.

title: NYSDEC Environmental Site Database Search
agency: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation
usefulFor: Petroleum and chemical bulk storage information
caveat: A database result can require document review, and no search result is not proof that a residential tank never existed.
requestMethod: Search public environmental site records before filing FOIL.
requestRequirements: Use address variants and every case, spill, site, or facility identifier recovered.
responseTime: Immediate when the system is available
fallbackRoute: Use DECinfo Locator or the NYSDEC FOIL Records Access Center for specific existing records.

title: NYSDEC Spill Incidents dataset
agency: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation
caveat: A reported incident is not a parcel-level risk score, and absence from the dataset is not a tank-free certificate.
requestMethod: Search, filter, or export the public dataset.
requestRequirements: Confirm the incident address and do not attribute a nearby record to the subject parcel without an identifier match.
fallbackRoute: Use the spill number in the environmental site search or a NYSDEC FOIL request for incident files.

title: NYSDEC FOIL Records Access Center
searchBy: Spill, site, facility, or program identifiers
usefulFor: Tracking and messaging on a pending request
Retrieving records not available through public databases
caveat: DEC is not required to create a new record. Requests should identify existing records as specifically as possible.
requestMethod: Submit through the DEC GovQA online FOIL system; written alternatives are also published.
requestRequirements: Describe the records, relevant dates, names, identifiers, preferred format, and contact information.
fee: Up to $0.25 per standard paper copy or actual authorized reproduction cost; notice is provided before release
responseTime: Within five business days: records, denial, or acknowledgment with a reasonable estimate
fallbackRoute: Contact the Records Access Office at 518-402-9522 with the request number; appeal instructions are published on the FOIL page.
